tree.note: Implemented in the shared world-aware-tools audit worktree without staging or committing. Pre-existing staged edits in gate-scope.suite.int.test.ts were preserved.

outcome.canonicalFrontDoor: structure now routes normal run, list, explain, JSON, and whole/changed/file/folder/package/project requests through planPolicyArgv and executePolicyPlan. The disjoint --void tombstone grammar remains on structure; verify --list stage semantics were not changed.
outcome.scopedArtifacts: Every run records its requested source scope. Narrowed source scopes and policy selections remain available only through their run slot; reports/check-structure.json publishes only for an all-policy, whole-scope verdict. structure-delta refuses source-scoped slots because they do not share the whole-corpus denominator.
outcome.unpopulatedResources: The planner accepts an empty authored resource-path contribution only when every declared resource kind is classified as unpopulated by contract/resource-declaration.ts. Empty resource rows are omitted from the execution manifest, preserving exact planner/executor reconciliation.
outcome.nonGitWholeScope: A standalone planted root with no Git repository derives whole-scope source identity from the exact ts-morph workspace the pass executes and records inventory.source=workspace. Git is still attempted first, and any inventory failure in a real Git worktree remains a refusal; no fixture is Git-initialized to hide the distinction.
outcome.stableRefusal: Structure refusals again begin with the documented `structure takes at most --fail-on-warnings` compatibility prefix while retaining the precise parser reason and expanded usage.
outcome.legacyWholeRunSemantics: All-policy load failures still leave an incomplete run stub. Resource acquisition failures remain programmatic-planner refusals by default, while structure explicitly carries them into execution so the dispatcher can write the established incomplete owner, withholding, and authority receipts.
outcome.executionWorkspaceParity: Production planning now derives source populations from the exact ts-morph workspace execution will walk, while retaining Git inventory and compiler membership as separate scope evidence.

reviewRefutation.result: RED: 1 file, 3 tests, 2 failed. The default structure run exited 2 because Git inventory was required in a standalone planted root; the typo refusal omitted the stable prefix.

redFirstProof.method: The touched production sources were temporarily restored to HEAD while the new tests remained, then restored from lane-local backups; no stash, checkout, or restore command was used.
